data.one_liner: An implementation of an Optional type in Dart, similar to Swift.
data.what_it_does: The plain_optional package defines a type Optional<T> that contains an object of type T optionally. It provides methods like map and flatMap to safely handle nullable values.
use_when: You want a Swift-style Optional<T> type in Dart
You need to distinguish between uninitialized or absent values versus explicit nulls
avoid_when: Dart's built-in nullable types and null-safety operators are sufficient for your use case
strengths: Provides familiar map and flatMap functions for handling optionals
weaknesses: Requires using a custom wrapper class instead of native Dart types
data.minimal_example:
Optional<String> optionalValue = Optional.of('Hello');
String? unwrapped = optionalValue.unsafe;
